rationale: bugs_open/083 fix candidate 2, OWNER RULING 2026-08-15 (put to the owner by bugfix_277's trail 7b0e2833, where the improvement_guardian seat objected at high severity that a producer born 'triaged' removes the observe-only stage; the owner chose to restore the stage properly rather than accept the workaround). The detected->triaged promoter (TriageDetectedItemsAction) has exactly one live carrier, improvement-loop, whose only driver improvement-sweep has been disabled since 2026-05-02 (IMP-016) — so status='detected' has been a queue with no consumer, and producers routed around it by filing born-triaged. This change gives the promoter its OWN scheduled task on the estate's existing pure-SQL pattern (SCH-006; feasibility-recheck is the exact precedent, and cmd/scheduler/main.go:269-277 confirms fire_message=false runs the pre_query and fires nothing): 900s cadence, at most 20 promotions per tick oldest-first, and a KNOWN-GOOD rule that is data — the handler is a live active agent_definitions row AND the exact (item_type, handler_agent) pair has >=1 lifetime complete (083's own candidate 4: check the handler is real). A pair with zero completes is HELD until a human promotes one row by hand, so every new type's first dispatch is a deliberate canary. The UPDATE mirrors the original promoter's in effect (status, triaged_at, spec.original_pipeline, pipeline='build') — and pipeline='build' was MEASURED load-bearing this session: the scheduler GATE (build-pipeline-trigger pre_query) requires a pipeline='build' triaged item to wake the loop, though the loop's loader itself does not filter. Applied and ledger-recorded 2026-08-15; the seed's verify block asserts a disconfirmable partition of the live pile: 70 detected = 66 promotable + 4 held + 0 unroutable. The one Go change: bugfix_277's producer returns from Status 'triaged' to 'detected' — the revert promised on that trail. improvement-sweep itself stays paused; discovery has SCH-025, triage now has this, and the auto-fix half remains a separate owner decision.

plan.risks: 1) A promoted item still passes the dispatcher's own gates (site lock, attempt_count, claim gate, handler-exists) — promotion is not dispatch; but 20 promotions/tick into the build queue is new steady-state load; the first hour drains the 66 and the cadence then idles unless discovery rotation (SCH-025) files more. 2) The known-good rule trusts ONE lifetime complete per pair; a pair whose only complete was a false success (016b: complete is not proof) qualifies — the dispatcher's failure path (attempt_count, 3 strikes -> failed) bounds the damage per item, and 083's verify criterion 3 (verify at the live page) is the intended check. 3) The 4 held rows sit until someone canaries the pair; if nobody does, they age exactly as before this change — a stated residual, not a regression. 4) The producer revert is inert until the next chassis roll; between now and then required_fields_missing items are born triaged (as for the last few hours) — harmless, the router handles both. 5) improvement-sweep remains paused: the auto-fix half of the loop is a separate owner decision, not silently re-armed by this.
